description: Freight Analysis Framework origin-destination flows: FAF5.7.1 state and FAF-zone flows by domestic mode and SCTG2 commodity (tons, constant and current value, ton-miles; 2017-2024 estimates, 2030-2050 baseline forecasts and low/high scenarios flagged as projections), reprocessed 1997-2012 state history, state-level import/export legs by foreign region, and the FAF6.0 2022 state benchmark

source.unit_notes: Tons in thousand short tons; FAF5 value in million 2017 constant dollars (current_value in million current dollars); FAF6.0 value in million 2022 dollars; ton-miles in millions. All values are modeled estimates, not survey counts.
